installCommand: echo 'Composer runs in the vercel-php runtime; the frontend is built before deploy'
buildCommand: if [ ! -f public/build/manifest.json ]; then echo 'Run npm run build before deploying'; exit 1; fi; rm -rf .vercel-static && mkdir .vercel-static && cp -R public/. .vercel-static && rm -f .vercel-static/index.php
